say:19:1621509026:1.female: Oh, please. I did keep it somewhere safe.

choice:23:0:1.female: Did I offer to help you?

say:2:1621511002:1.text: Um, w-we did steal it from Meowris, b-but we ran into s-some human students on the way back...
say:2:1621511002:1.source_cn: 呃，从、从从……喵丽丝那边确实偷到了，但、但回来的路上...

say:4:1621511003:1.text: We dropped the book to avoid getting caught, and those students took it back to the library...
say:4:1621511003:1.source_cn: 我们怕暴露，只能丢下书……他们好像把它带回了图书馆。

say:5:1621511004:1.text: What?! That book's all about wicked magic!

say:10:1621511008:1.source_cn: 既然我们没法销毁那本书，就只能赶在她得逞之前，正面对决...

say:6:1621522006:1.male: Meowhaha! You're becoming part of something great!

say:0:1621523001:0.text: The day of the final showdown has come. I have to be there.
say:0:1621523001:0.source_cn: 决战日到了，我得过去看看。
say:0:1621523001:0.male: The day of the final showdown has come. I have to be there.
say:0:1621523001:0.female: The day of the final showdown has come. I have to be there.

say:1:1621524001:1.text: Meowris, your ambition's gone too far! You're not liberating your followers, you're just forcing them to hail you as king!
say:1:1621524001:1.source_cn: 喵丽丝，你的野心太膨胀了。这不是带领大家走向自由，而是...

say:2:1621524002:1.text: Just so you know, titles mean nothing to me. I actually get what kind of future animals want, unlike you.
say:2:1621524002:1.source_cn: 王不王的无所谓，我只是比你更清楚——什么叫未来。

say:3:1621524003:1.text: The future isn't for you alone to decide! As long as I'm still standing, I won't let you have your way!
say:3:1621524003:1.source_cn: 未来不是你一个猫说了算的！只要我还站着，就不会让你得逞！

say:4:1621524004:1.text: Well said. I'd believe you if I didn't see your legs shaking.
say:4:1621524004:1.source_cn: 站着？你抖成那样，是准备原地蹦跶吗？

say:5:1621524005:1.text: What a hassle... Do we really have to do this the hard way? Can't you just open your eyes and see reason yourself?
say:5:1621524005:1.source_cn: 真麻烦……非得打一架，你才肯听劝吗？

say:6:1621524006:1.text: Meowris summons a fierce gale that sweeps the ground, hurling debris in every direction.
say:6:1621524006:1.source_cn: 喵丽丝的魔法像利箭一样刮过，带起飞沙走石和断裂的草木。
say:6:1621524006:1.male: Meowris summons a fierce gale that sweeps the ground, hurling debris in every direction.
say:6:1621524006:1.female: Meowris summons a fierce gale that sweeps the ground, hurling debris in every direction.

say:7:1621524007:1.text: You are surprised to see a cat casting magic, but the spell is weak.
say:7:1621524007:1.source_cn: 你没想到一只猫竟然会施展魔法，倒是有些惊讶，但那魔法力...
say:7:1621524007:1.male: You are surprised to see a cat casting magic, but the spell is weak.
say:7:1621524007:1.female: You are surprised to see a cat casting magic, but the spell is weak.

say:8:1621524008:1.text: It might look scary to animals, but all it really does is make Meowris look cool...
say:8:1621524008:1.source_cn: 对动物来说或许有点可怕，但根本伤不了人。倒是带着明显的...
say:8:1621524008:1.male: It might look scary to animals, but all it really does is make Meowris look cool...
say:8:1621524008:1.female: It might look scary to animals, but all it really does is make Meowris look cool...

say:9:1621524009:1.text: With a low growl, Woofdale leaps forward against the wind, placing himself in front of his allies.
say:9:1621524009:1.source_cn: 汪达尔低吼一声，奋力跃起，强行穿过风障，用身体挡在伙伴前面。
say:9:1621524009:1.male: With a low growl, Woofdale leaps forward against the wind, placing himself in front of his allies.
say:9:1621524009:1.female: With a low growl, Woofdale leaps forward against the wind, placing himself in front of his allies.

say:10:1621524010:1.text: I'm not here to defeat your magic... I'm here to block your path!
say:10:1621524010:1.source_cn: 我不是来赢你魔法的……我是来拦住你这条路的！

say:11:1621524011:1.text: With just your body?! Let's see how long you can last!
say:11:1621524011:1.source_cn: 用血肉拦风？我看你能扛住我几招！

say:12:1621524012:1.text: Meowris flicks its tail, conjuring several runes in the air. In an instant, beams of silvery light shoot forth, giving rise to a tornado.
say:12:1621524012:1.source_cn: 喵丽丝尾巴一甩，空中凝出数道浮动的魔法符文，金属色的光...

say:14:1621524014:1.text: She raises her front paw, and the tornado contracts rapidly before crashing down. When the light fades, Woofdale collapses to the ground, panting heavily, but still holds his position to protect his squad.
say:14:1621524014:1.source_cn: 她举起前爪，魔法漩涡猛地收紧，轰然砸下。光芒褪去，汪达...

say:15:1621524015:1.text: Such is the cost of being so stubborn.
say:15:1621524015:1.source_cn: 一意孤行，就是这种下场。

say:16:1621524016:1.text: You won't... win the support of all animals... This... isn't over yet.
say:16:1621524016:1.source_cn: 你……不会赢得所有动物的心……这场战斗，还没完……

say:18:1621524017:1.text: Meowris gives no reply. Meanwhile, the members of the Hero Squad start to scurry away.
say:18:1621524017:1.source_cn: 喵丽丝没有回应，其他汪达尔小队的动物见状开始四散逃走。

say:1:1621525001:1.text: What an easy win. Woofdale is even weaker than I thought.
say:1:1621525001:1.source_cn: 真是场无聊的决战，汪达尔那家伙比我想象中还要弱。
say:1:1621525001:1.male: What an easy win. Woofdale is even weaker than I thought.
say:1:1621525001:1.female: What an easy win. Woofdale is even weaker than I thought.

say:2:1621525002:1.text: Anyway, this victory is just the beginning. I'll need many more like this to rule the world.
say:2:1621525002:1.source_cn: 不过这场胜利只是开始，世界之王的征程，从这一刻起正式启程。
say:2:1621525002:1.male: Anyway, this victory is just the beginning. I'll need many more like this to rule the world.
say:2:1621525002:1.female: Anyway, this victory is just the beginning. I'll need many more like this to rule the world.

choice_prompt:3:1621525002.text: Anyway, this victory is just the beginning. I'll need many more like this to rule the world.
choice_prompt:3:1621525002.source_cn: 不过这场胜利只是开始，世界之王的征程，从这一刻起正式启程。
choice_prompt:3:1621525002.male: Anyway, this victory is just the beginning. I'll need many more like this to rule the world.
choice_prompt:3:1621525002.female: Anyway, this victory is just the beginning. I'll need many more like this to rule the world.

say:4:1621525003:1.source_cn: 这份支持我会记在心里。

say:5:1621525008:1.text: When that day comes, every glory I claim will be yours to share!
say:5:1621525008:1.source_cn: 到那时，天下盛宴与你共享，荣耀与权力，必将属于你一份！
say:5:1621525008:1.male: When that day comes, every glory I claim will be yours to share!
say:5:1621525008:1.female: When that day comes, every glory I claim will be yours to share!

choice:3:0:1.source_cn: 我会一直默默支持你的

say:7:1621525004:1.text: I have no problem embracing uncertainty, for it gives me endless opportunities.
say:7:1621525004:1.source_cn: 正是这份未知，才给了我无尽的机会。
say:7:1621525004:1.male: I have no problem embracing uncertainty, for it gives me endless opportunities.
say:7:1621525004:1.female: I have no problem embracing uncertainty, for it gives me endless opportunities.

say:8:1621525005:1.text: As long as you remain my ally, the ball will always be at my feet.
say:8:1621525005:1.source_cn: 只要你站在我这边，未来便在我脚下。
say:8:1621525005:1.male: As long as you remain my ally, the ball will always be at my feet.
say:8:1621525005:1.female: As long as you remain my ally, the ball will always be at my feet.

choice:3:1:2.source_cn: 山外有山，未来充满未知

say:9:1621525006:1.text: Trust is the source of power.
say:9:1621525006:1.male: Trust is the source of power.
say:9:1621525006:1.female: Trust is the source of power.

say:10:1621525007:1.text: One day, you'll witness the dawn of a world that truly belongs to us animals.
say:10:1621525007:1.source_cn: 我不会让你失望，你将看到一个真正属于我们的新世界。
say:10:1621525007:1.male: One day, you'll witness the dawn of a world that truly belongs to us animals.
say:10:1621525007:1.female: One day, you'll witness the dawn of a world that truly belongs to us animals.

say:1:1621526001:1.text: Woof! I knew you'd support me! Thank you, my friend! I know I put my trust in the right place!
say:1:1621526001:1.source_cn: 汪！我就知道你会支持我的！感谢你，我的朋友！你果然是可...
say:1:1621526001:1.male: Woof! I knew you'd support me! Thank you, my friend! I know I put my trust in the right place!
say:1:1621526001:1.female: Woof! I knew you'd support me! Thank you, my friend! I know I put my trust in the right place!

say:2:1621526002:1.text: I'll set up a showdown with Meowris soon. Once I fix the time and place, I'll let you know.
say:2:1621526002:1.source_cn: 我会正式向喵丽丝下战书！时间和地点我会通知你的！
say:2:1621526002:1.male: I'll set up a showdown with Meowris soon. Once I fix the time and place, I'll let you know.
say:2:1621526002:1.female: I'll set up a showdown with Meowris soon. Once I fix the time and place, I'll let you know.

say:3:1621526003:1.text: Let's protect the Serene Lyceum together!
say:3:1621526003:1.source_cn: 狼阁下！让我们一起守护莱希拉姆！
say:3:1621526003:1.male: Let's protect the Serene Lyceum together!
say:3:1621526003:1.female: Let's protect the Serene Lyceum together!

say:4:1621526004:1.text: You must be there on the day of the showdown. We can't win without you!
say:4:1621526004:1.source_cn: 决战日你一定要来，你可是我们不可缺的力量！
say:4:1621526004:1.male: You must be there on the day of the showdown. We can't win without you!
say:4:1621526004:1.female: You must be there on the day of the showdown. We can't win without you!

say:0:1621527001:0.text: Today's the showdown. I've got to help Woofdale.
say:0:1621527001:0.source_cn: 决战日到了，我得去帮汪达尔。
say:0:1621527001:0.male: Today's the showdown. I've got to help Woofdale.
say:0:1621527001:0.female: Today's the showdown. I've got to help Woofdale.

say:2:1621528001:1.text: Woofdale, your defiance is pointless. Feel the wrath of the storm!
say:2:1621528001:1.source_cn: 汪达尔，你的抵抗毫无意义，感受风暴的怒吼吧！

say:3:1621528002:1.text: A vicious gust of wind lashes at Woofdale. He sidesteps swiftly, his gaze unflinching and full of determination.
say:3:1621528002:1.source_cn: 一股凌厉的风刃劈向汪达尔，他迅速侧身躲避，目光坚定不屈。

say:6:1621528004:1.text: No way... My wind magic shouldn't be this weak...
say:6:1621528004:1.source_cn: 不……我的风魔法这么轻易就……

say:7:1621528007:1.text: Before Meowris can speak further, Woofdale and you strike in unison. As he pounces on Meowris' wind shield, you unleash a powerful blast of magic against it.
say:7:1621528007:1.source_cn: 话音未落，你和汪达尔默契配合，一道强烈的魔法光束与利爪...
say:7:1621528007:1.male: Before Meowris can speak further, Woofdale and you strike in unison. As he pounces on Meowris' wind shield, you unleash a powerful blast of magic against it.
say:7:1621528007:1.female: Before Meowris can speak further, Woofdale and you strike in unison. As he pounces on Meowris' wind shield, you unleash a powerful blast of magic against it.

say:8:1621528008:1.text: The next moment, the shield shatters, silencing the raging wind. Meowris staggers backward, a rare look of shock on her face.
say:8:1621528008:1.source_cn: 喵丽丝的风盾瞬间破碎，狂风骤止，喵丽丝踉跄后退，脸上露...

say:9:1621528009:1.text: This is impossible... How am I losing to a bunch of idiots...
say:9:1621528009:1.source_cn: 不可能……我竟然被你们几个蠢货给……

say:10:1621528010:1.text: Hmph, nothing is impossible! Watch this!
say:10:1621528010:1.source_cn: 哼，事到如今已经太迟了！看招！

choice_prompt:11:1621528010.text: Hmph, nothing is impossible! Watch this!
choice_prompt:11:1621528010.source_cn: 哼，事到如今已经太迟了！看招！

say:12:1621528011:1.text: Hmph, I'm only sparing her because of you.
say:12:1621528011:1.source_cn: 哼，既然狼阁下你这样说了，我就饶了她！
say:12:1621528011:1.male: Hmph, I'm only sparing her because of you.
say:12:1621528011:1.female: Hmph, I'm only sparing her because of you.

narration:14:1621528015:1.text: From that day on, tales of the Hero Squad became well-known throughout the Serene Lyceum's forest.

narration:15:1621528016:1.text: With the storm gone, sunlight streams through the canopy, bathing every member of the squad.

say:17:1621528012:1.text: Alright... Since you've said so, I'll let her go!
say:17:1621528012:1.source_cn: 好吧……既然狼阁下你开口了，我就饶了她！
say:17:1621528012:1.male: Alright... Since you've said so, I'll let her go!
say:17:1621528012:1.female: Alright... Since you've said so, I'll let her go!

choice:11:1:2.source_cn: 喵丽丝已经得到教训了

say:18:1621528013:1.text: I know what to do, my friend...
say:18:1621528013:1.male: I know what to do, my friend...
say:18:1621528013:1.female: I know what to do, my friend...

choice:5:1:2.source_cn: 快速冲刺，破坏喵丽丝的法阵

say:20:1621528006:1.text: You think two against me is enough?!

choice:5:2:3.source_cn: 与汪达尔联手发动突袭

say:1:1621529001:1.text: We've won... and it's all because of you, my friend.
say:1:1621529001:1.source_cn: 我们赢了……但这多亏了你，狼阁下。
say:1:1621529001:1.male: We've won... and it's all because of you, my friend.
say:1:1621529001:1.female: We've won... and it's all because of you, my friend.

say:2:1621529002:1.text: Your magic clearly outclasses Meowris. Honestly, I think the world could be yours if you wanted it…
say:2:1621529002:1.source_cn: 没想到你的魔法能如此碾压喵丽丝，实话说，我觉得只要你愿...
say:2:1621529002:1.male: Your magic clearly outclasses Meowris. Honestly, I think the world could be yours if you wanted it…
say:2:1621529002:1.female: Your magic clearly outclasses Meowris. Honestly, I think the world could be yours if you wanted it…

say:3:1621529003:1.text: You could have seized power after defeating Meowris, but you didn't... That shows your true righteousness, and I'm honored to be your ally!
say:3:1621529003:1.source_cn: 但你没有那样做，反而选择挺身而出阻止她——这才是真正的...
say:3:1621529003:1.male: You could have seized power after defeating Meowris, but you didn't... That shows your true righteousness, and I'm honored to be your ally!
say:3:1621529003:1.female: You could have seized power after defeating Meowris, but you didn't... That shows your true righteousness, and I'm honored to be your ally!

choice_prompt:4:1621529003.text: You could have seized power after defeating Meowris, but you didn't... That shows your true righteousness, and I'm honored to be your ally!
choice_prompt:4:1621529003.source_cn: 但你没有那样做，反而选择挺身而出阻止她——这才是真正的正直与荣耀。能和你并肩作战，是我的荣幸！
choice_prompt:4:1621529003.male: You could have seized power after defeating Meowris, but you didn't... That shows your true righteousness, and I'm honored to be your ally!
choice_prompt:4:1621529003.female: You could have seized power after defeating Meowris, but you didn't... That shows your true righteousness, and I'm honored to be your ally!

say:5:1621529004:1.text: You're the very epitome of a true hero, my friend!
say:5:1621529004:1.source_cn: 狼阁下……你的气度，简直就是英雄中的英雄！
say:5:1621529004:1.male: You're the very epitome of a true hero, my friend!
say:5:1621529004:1.female: You're the very epitome of a true hero, my friend!

say:6:1621529006:1.text: One more thing... Even though we won convincingly, I know Meowris won't give up so easily.
say:6:1621529006:1.source_cn: 不过……即便是一场碾压的决斗，凭我对喵丽丝的了解，她绝...
say:6:1621529006:1.male: One more thing... Even though we won convincingly, I know Meowris won't give up so easily.
say:6:1621529006:1.female: One more thing... Even though we won convincingly, I know Meowris won't give up so easily.

say:7:1621529007:1.text: Like the wind, she may have died down today, but that doesn't mean she won't come back tomorrow.
say:7:1621529007:1.source_cn: 她就像风，哪怕今天停了，明天依旧可能卷土重来。
say:7:1621529007:1.male: Like the wind, she may have died down today, but that doesn't mean she won't come back tomorrow.
say:7:1621529007:1.female: Like the wind, she may have died down today, but that doesn't mean she won't come back tomorrow.

say:8:1621529008:1.text: So, we shouldn't be too quick to let our guard down.
say:8:1621529008:1.source_cn: 所以，我们不能松懈，我们的小队必须永远保持警觉。
say:8:1621529008:1.male: So, we shouldn't be too quick to let our guard down.
say:8:1621529008:1.female: So, we shouldn't be too quick to let our guard down.

say:9:1621529009:1.text: Would you be willing to face more challenges ahead with me?
say:9:1621529009:1.source_cn: 你愿意继续支持我，对抗未来的风暴吗？
say:9:1621529009:1.male: Would you be willing to face more challenges ahead with me?
say:9:1621529009:1.female: Would you be willing to face more challenges ahead with me?

choice_prompt:10:1621529009.text: Would you be willing to face more challenges ahead with me?
choice_prompt:10:1621529009.source_cn: 你愿意继续支持我，对抗未来的风暴吗？
choice_prompt:10:1621529009.male: Would you be willing to face more challenges ahead with me?
choice_prompt:10:1621529009.female: Would you be willing to face more challenges ahead with me?

say:11:1621529010:1.text: With you around... I feel like I can handle anything.
say:11:1621529010:1.source_cn: 有你这句话……我就不怕任何风暴了。
say:11:1621529010:1.male: With you around... I feel like I can handle anything.
say:11:1621529010:1.female: With you around... I feel like I can handle anything.

say:12:1621529011:1.text: It's reassuring to know I won't be alone when Meowris makes her comeback.
say:12:1621529011:1.source_cn: 无论喵丽丝什么时候卷土重来，我知道，我不是一个汪。
say:12:1621529011:1.male: It's reassuring to know I won't be alone when Meowris makes her comeback.
say:12:1621529011:1.female: It's reassuring to know I won't be alone when Meowris makes her comeback.

say:13:1621529016:1.text: When everyone else told me to give up, you were the only one who believed in me. That teaches me one thing...
say:13:1621529016:1.source_cn: 当初很多动物都劝我放弃，只有你坚定地支持我，这让我相信——
say:13:1621529016:1.male: When everyone else told me to give up, you were the only one who believed in me. That teaches me one thing...
say:13:1621529016:1.female: When everyone else told me to give up, you were the only one who believed in me. That teaches me one thing...

say:14:1621529017:1.text: A true king is defined by an unyielding spirit.
say:14:1621529017:1.source_cn: 真正的王，是那份永不熄灭的意志。
say:14:1621529017:1.male: A true king is defined by an unyielding spirit.
say:14:1621529017:1.female: A true king is defined by an unyielding spirit.

say:15:1621529018:1.text: I want all animals to understand this! A king isn't a specific animal. If we're ready, we can all be the kings of our own lives!
say:15:1621529018:1.source_cn: 所以，我就是要证明给所有动物们看！王不是某只动物！我们...
say:15:1621529018:1.male: I want all animals to understand this! A king isn't a specific animal. If we're ready, we can all be the kings of our own lives!
say:15:1621529018:1.female: I want all animals to understand this! A king isn't a specific animal. If we're ready, we can all be the kings of our own lives!

say:18:1621529013:1.text: I'll do the same for you!
say:18:1621529013:1.source_cn: 不过下一次，由我来挡在你面前才是！
say:18:1621529013:1.male: I'll do the same for you!
say:18:1621529013:1.female: I'll do the same for you!

choice:10:1:2.text: I'll protect you when she returns.
choice:10:1:2.source_cn: 等她再来，我还会挡在你前面
choice:10:1:2.male: I'll protect you when she returns.
choice:10:1:2.female: I'll protect you when she returns.

say:19:1621529014:1.text: Peace is just the time to catch our breath before the next battle.
say:19:1621529014:1.source_cn: 没错，和平只是下一场战斗前的深呼吸。
say:19:1621529014:1.male: Peace is just the time to catch our breath before the next battle.
say:19:1621529014:1.female: Peace is just the time to catch our breath before the next battle.

say:20:1621529015:1.text: We must be ready at all times for the next challenge.
say:20:1621529015:1.source_cn: 我们必须时刻做好下一次迎风而上的准备。
say:20:1621529015:1.male: We must be ready at all times for the next challenge.
say:20:1621529015:1.female: We must be ready at all times for the next challenge.

choice:10:2:3.text: Indeed, we haven't reached the finish line.
choice:10:2:3.source_cn: 你说得对，和平从不是终点
choice:10:2:3.male: Indeed, we haven't reached the finish line.
choice:10:2:3.female: Indeed, we haven't reached the finish line.

say:21:1621529005:1.text: Woof! You're a real class act!
say:21:1621529005:1.source_cn: 汪！这才是我心中真正的英雄！
say:21:1621529005:1.male: Woof! You're a real class act!
say:21:1621529005:1.female: Woof! You're a real class act!

cinematic_dialogue:1:1621508001:.text: Let us welcome an era where we no longer live by human rules!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1621508001:.source_cn: 从今往后，不再是人类制定规则——

cinematic_dialogue:1:1621508002:.text: We, the animals, shall forge a new order!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1621508002:.source_cn: 是我们动物自己，书写新秩序的时代！

cinematic_dialogue:1:1621508003:.source_cn: 喵丽丝！喵丽丝！支持喵丽丝大人！
